I'm hiring: Revenue Operations Manager — NYC (Hybrid) [Sona](https://www.sona.ai/) is building the next generation of AI-native workforce management for frontline industries. $100M+ raised, 140+ team, Series B backed by Felicis, Northzone, and Gradient Ventures (Google).
We're actively scaling into the US market and looking for someone to own the data foundation behind our revenue engine - CRM architecture, integrations across HubSpot/Gong/Lemlist/Sales Nav and the wider GTM stack, data quality, reporting, and automation. This is a hands-on, technically deep role for a builder who wants to help shape a GTM function in a new market, not maintain one that's already set.
Looking for: 4+ years in CRM admin (HubSpot preferred), integration experience (APIs, n8n/Zapier), and a genuine love for clean data and systems that just work.
$140k–$180k + equity, hybrid NYC (2–3 days in office), health insurance from day one, 401k match, and some great perks.
Apply here: [https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/sona/857d2cf4-1b32-4cdb-b9af-794accd3aa16](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/sona/857d2cf4-1b32-4cdb-b9af-794accd3aa16)
